{
  "up": "Select molecule_chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles
Join molecule_dictionary m ON m.molregno = a.molregno
Join activities a ON a.molregno = m.molregno
Join assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
Join target_dictionary t ON ass.tid = t.tid
Join target_type tt ON t.target_type = tt.target_type
Filter tt.target_type = 'PROTEIN' AND t.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
Join compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = m.molregno
Return molecule_chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles
Sort by compound_chembl_id"
}
